note: Data of the plan of feature 109. spec.md stands where the two differ.

proposer.capability: Runs without interaction and ends by itself
Takes the prompt by standard input, by a file, or as an argument with a declared size limit
Works in a given directory, writes files and runs commands there, without asking
Has a declared way to suppress permission prompts, or declares that none exists
Its credential can be checked before the first pass without a paid call, or it declares that no such check exists

completion.capability: One prompt in, one text reply out
No tools, by construction or by a declared mechanism proven per call; or the second form
A known context window in tokens, with its source
A fresh session on every call
Typed failures for at least authentication, rate limit or quota, and context overflow
An identity of provider and model
